caseName: Bandy v. United States Attorney General
caseNameFull: Bandy v. United States Attorney General
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Rogovin, Meyer Rothwacks and Richard B. Buhrman for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
